name: once
description: Execution safety for consequential external side effects across ambiguous retries, lost responses, idempotency gaps, reconciliation, and multi-agent handoffs.

interface.longDescription: Assess and protect consequential external side effects that may be retried after an ambiguous timeout, lost response, crash, redelivery, or agent handoff. Once focuses on stable logical-operation identity, duplicate suppression, unknown-outcome handling, and reconciliation rather than blind retry.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo for retry-after-unknown-outcome and duplicate side-effect risk.
Make this payment or refund safe after an ambiguous timeout or lost response.
Find idempotency gaps, reconciliation needs, and cross-agent duplicate execution risks in this workflow.
